title: Sync lore docs after quest 0.3.2 / lore 0.4.1 (normalizeFileLink dead-link fix)
description: Publishing quest 0.3.2 (QCLI-220's path field) activated a latent lore bug: lore 0.4.0 appended a canonical .md to the new path field, producing dead links like .quest/tasks/QCLI-1.json.md in managed <!-- lore:tasks --> blocks. Not a defect in 0.3.2 -- a dormant lore bug quest's correct release made reachable. lore-cli fixed it (normalizeFileLink) and published 0.4.1. lore check currently reports 10 managed-block-drift errors across docs/stories/*.md, all caused by the version-skew window, none by content edits. Fix: upgrade to lore 0.4.1 (already installed, verified via lore --version), run lore sync, inspect the diff (task links should read .quest/tasks/QCLI-N.json not .json.md, including at least one .quest/completed/ record to prove path is a live lookup), then lore check to confirm exit 0.

acceptanceCriteria.text: lore --version reads 0.4.1 before syncing (not trusted from npm install output)
lore sync --dry-run --json comes back clean (no not_found, empty orphanedIndexes) before the real sync

lore sync run and its diff inspected: task links in docs/stories/*.md read .quest/tasks/QCLI-N.json or .quest/completed/QCLI-N.json, never *.json.md, and at least one completed-location link checked specifically
Change lands on a feature branch with a PR, not a direct commit to dev, then dev promoted to main to keep the two in sync
